title: Last closed business date advances via COB and catch-up (C2501)

source.test: As an admin I would like to see that last closed business date got updated after COB catch up job finished

scenario: Disburse a 1000 loan on 01 Jan 2022 (last closed business date null), run COB at 02 Jan and 05 Jan, then COB catch-up; the last closed business date becomes 04 Jan 2022 and the loan closes after a 1000 repayment.
grade: Assert COB advances last_closed_business_date to the prior business day and catch-up walks it to 04 Jan; a full repayment closes the loan CLOSED_OBLIGATIONS_MET.
